body:
@syntaxerror247 I did a quick test, and there's still an issue when switching from touch to mouse.

Also stylus seems to handle like a mouse instead of a touch, is that intended?

> @syntaxerror247 I did a quick test, and there's still an issue when switching from touch to mouse.

Pushed a fix, please re-check.

> Also stylus seems to handle like a mouse instead of a touch, is that intended?

It wasn't intended. I was expecting stylus to generate touch events but I guess it generates mouse. I don't have a stylus to test, I'll read online about stylus input.
Edit: Yeah, we are recognizing stylus input as mouse event. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6ef60dc279b2c58a94ffc57bf98eefc9663f7907/platform/android/java/lib/src/main/java/org/godotengine/godot/input/GodotInputHandler.java#L539-L551

> A quick draft for iOS long-press support, since we are handling all touches manually (not using any system gesture recognizers), we should not use system one for long-press either, it will create a mess with canceled events.
> 
> Click me

I've applied this and created a commit in #122865.

> > doesn't work with pencil.
> 
> Scroll do work, and press is likely not working because pencil immediately start produce move events after the initial touch event.

Added a drag threshold. Does tab selection work now?
